sensors.grant.collectorRefused.grantTitl: This collector's reports are refused: its grant does not allow them

sensors.grant.err.changed: The grant changed since you opened it. It was reloaded; review it and try again.
sensors.grant.suggestion.body: The narrowest profile that admits every job this sensor ran. It is never wider than the current grant; the trust level is kept.
sensors.grant.suggestion.changed: The suggestion changed since it was shown. It was reloaded; review it and try again.
sensors.grant.suggestion.confirmDesc: From its next request the sensor gets only the jobs this profile admits. A job outside it (for example a schedule that did not run in the window) is refused and named in the sensor timeline. You may be asked to confirm your identity. This is audited.

sensors.grant.suggestion.idleBody: This sensor did nothing in the window. The default profile of its kind is suggested.
sensors.grant.suggestion.incomplete: This sensor ran too many different jobs to check them all. Pick its profile with Narrow.

sensors.install.trustCollector.help: A new collector starts untrusted, and the platform refuses every report it sends until it is trusted. Trusted lets it send asset reports without a job: they can add new assets but never change existing ones, and scope exclusions still apply. Tick this only for a collector you install yourself. It is audited and every administrator is notified.
sensors.install.trustCollector.label: Trust this collector to push asset reports
sensors.install.trustCollector.noPermiss: Only an administrator who may widen sensor grants can trust a collector. You can create it now and have it trusted later on the sensor's Grant.
sensors.install.trustCollector.notApplie: The collector was created, but trusting it failed. It stays untrusted until it is promoted on the sensor's Grant.

sensors.list.groupBy.label: Group sensors

Online: its next heartbeat is not yet due · Late: past due, still takes work · Stale: well past due, takes no new work · Offline: over 3 intervals (at least 90s) past due, at most {offlineAfter} without a heartbeat · Idle (CI): a CI sensor between runs
sensors.list.noZoneHint: takes jobs that no zone claims

sensors.localPolicy.desc.absentRequired: This sensor requires a local policy and has none: it refuses every job with a network target until the network owner installs one.
sensors.localPolicy.desc.enforced: The network owner installed a local policy. The sensor refuses every job outside it.
sensors.localPolicy.desc.notReported: This sensor runs an SDK that does not report a local policy.
sensors.localPolicy.desc.paused: The sensor owner engaged the local kill switch: the sensor runs no job until it is released.
sensors.localPolicy.digestHint: The digest the sensor reports for its local policy

sensors.localPolicy.guidance.2: Out-of-band callbacks (interactsh): used only by a job that asks for them, and the platform sends such jobs only when your organization allows interactsh.

sensors.localPolicy.requiredBody: This sensor refuses every job with a network target, custom templates and callbacks until the network owner installs a policy (the Local policy tab of the install commands).

sensors.optInBanner.ownerAfter: . Turning one on is audited and alerted, and a sensor still refuses what its own local policy does not allow.

sensors.optIns.audited: Turning it on is audited and alerted.
